title: Cover the remaining named-root journal census classes and precedence
outcome: The census's new exclusive primary labels and protection precedence have behavioral coverage beyond the current four exercised classes.
acceptance: Behavioral fixture cases cover previously untested named-root journal primary reasons and precedence, including reconciliation subtypes, evaluator versus selected-root custody, runtime root/opening/closing/report references, and known captured-generation custody preceding pending captures; assertions exercise census or admission behavior without pinning implementation text.
